@staticmethod
    def delete_room(db: Session, current_user: UserModel, room_id: int):
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Only admins may manage rooms", "Forbidden")

        if room_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        room = db.scalar(
            select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False)
        )
        if not room:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        # REQ-3-008: A room may be soft-deleted only if no appointment of any status references it
        appt_exists = db.scalar(
            select(AppointmentModel).where(AppointmentModel.room_id == room_id).limit(1)
        )
        if appt_exists:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                "Cannot delete room referenced by appointment records",
                "Conflict",
            )

        room.is_deleted = True
        room.active = False
        db.commit()

@staticmethod
    def list_animals(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        species: Optional[SpeciesEnum],
        active: Optional[bool],
        client_account_id: Optional[int],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> AnimalListResponse:
        if client_account_id is not None and current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "client_account_id filter permitted only to admins", "Forbidden")

        query = select(PatientAnimalModel)
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.client_account_id == current_user.id)
        elif client_account_id is not None:
            if client_account_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "client_account_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.client_account_id == client_account_id)

        if species is not None:
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.species == species.value)

        if active is not None:
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.active == active)

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "after_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(PatientAnimalModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        rows = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None
        if len(rows) > limit:
            items = rows[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = rows

        return AnimalListResponse(
            items=[AnimalResponse.model_validate(a) for a in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

            raise AppException(403, "room_id filter permitted only to admins", "Forbidden")

        query = select(AppointmentModel).join(
            PatientAnimalModel, AppointmentModel.animal_id == PatientAnimalModel.id
        )

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(PatientAnimalModel.client_account_id == current_user.id)

                select(PatientAnimalModel).where(PatientAnimalModel.id == animal_id)
            )

            if (
                current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value
                and animal.client_account_id != current_user.id
            ):
                raise AppException(403, "Access to animal appointments is forbidden", "Forbidden")
            query = query.where(AppointmentModel.animal_id == animal_id)

        if room_id is not None:

            room = db.scalar(
                select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False)
            )
            if not room:
                raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")
            query = query.where(AppointmentModel.room_id == room_id)

        if status_val is not None:
            query = query.where(AppointmentModel.status == status_val.value)

        if from_time is not None and to_time is not None:
            if from_time > to_time:

@staticmethod
    def list_rooms(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        room_type: Optional[RoomTypeEnum],
        active: Optional[bool],
        include_deleted: bool,
        name_prefix: Optional[str],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> RoomListResponse:
        if include_deleted and current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "include_deleted permitted only to admins", "Forbidden")

        query = select(RoomModel)
        if not include_deleted:
            query = query.where(RoomModel.is_deleted == False)

        if room_type is not None:
            query = query.where(RoomModel.room_type == room_type.value)

        if active is not None:
            query = query.where(RoomModel.active == active)

        if name_prefix is not None:
            prefix = name_prefix.strip()
            if not (1 <= len(prefix) <= 60):
                raise AppException(400, "name_prefix must be 1..60 characters", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(RoomModel.name.startswith(prefix))

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "after_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(RoomModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(RoomModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        rows = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None
        if len(rows) > limit:
            items = rows[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = rows

        return RoomListResponse(
            items=[RoomResponse.model_validate(r) for r in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def patch_appointment(
        db: Session,
        db_user: UserModel,
        appointment_id: int,
        payload: AppointmentPatchRequest,
    ) -> AppointmentModel:
        appt = AppointmentController.get_appointment(db, db_user, appointment_id)

        if appt.status != AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Appointment {appointment_id} is in '{appt.status}' status and cannot be modified",
                "Conflict",
            )

        fields_set = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        if not fields_set:
            raise AppException(400, "At least one field must be updated", "Bad Request")

        new_room_id = payload.room_id if payload.room_id is not None else appt.room_id
        new_start_at = payload.start_at if payload.start_at is not None else to_utc(appt.start_at)
        new_end_at = payload.end_at if payload.end_at is not None else to_utc(appt.end_at)
        new_reason = payload.reason if payload.reason is not None else appt.reason

        validate_appointment_interval(new_start_at, new_end_at)

        if new_room_id != appt.room_id:
            room = db.scalar(
                select(RoomModel).where(
                    RoomModel.id == new_room_id,
                    RoomModel.active == True,
                    RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if not room:
                raise AppException(404, f"Active room {new_room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        # Conflict check excluding this appointment
        check_overlap_conflicts(
            db,
            new_room_id,
            appt.animal_id,
            new_start_at,
            new_end_at,
            exclude_appointment_id=appt.id,
        )

        appt.room_id = new_room_id
        appt.start_at = new_start_at
        appt.end_at = new_end_at
        appt.reason = new_reason

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(appt)
        return appt

@staticmethod
    def patch_room(
        db: Session, current_user: UserModel, room_id: int, payload: RoomPatchRequest
    ) -> RoomModel:
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Only admins may manage rooms", "Forbidden")

        if room_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        room = db.scalar(
            select(RoomModel).where(RoomModel.id == room_id, RoomModel.is_deleted == False)
        )
        if not room:
            raise AppException(404, f"Room {room_id} not found", "Not Found")

        fields_set = payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
        if not fields_set:
            raise AppException(400, "At least one field must be updated", "Bad Request")

        if payload.name is not None and payload.name != room.name:
            dup = db.scalar(
                select(RoomModel).where(
                    RoomModel.name == payload.name,
                    RoomModel.id != room_id,
                    RoomModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if dup:
                raise AppException(409, f"Room name '{payload.name}' already exists", "Conflict")
            room.name = payload.name

        if payload.room_type is not None:
            room.room_type = payload.room_type.value

        if payload.capacity is not None:
            room.capacity = payload.capacity

        if payload.active is not None:
            if payload.active is False and room.active is True:
                # REQ-3-008: A room may be deactivated only if it has no SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointment
                active_appt = db.scalar(
                    select(AppointmentModel)
                    .where(
                        AppointmentModel.room_id == room_id,
                        AppointmentModel.status.in_(
                            [
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value,
                                AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value,
                            ]
                        ),
                    )
                    .limit(1)
                )
                if active_appt:
                    raise AppException(
                        409,
                        "Cannot deactivate room while SCHEDULED or CHECKED_IN appointments exist",
                        "Conflict",
                    )
            room.active = payload.active

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(room)
        return room

    def check_in_appointment(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        appointment_id: int,
        payload: AppointmentCheckInRequest,
    ) -> AppointmentModel:
        appt = AppointmentController.get_appointment(db, current_user, appointment_id)

        if appt.status != AppointmentStatusEnum.SCHEDULED.value:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Appointment must be in SCHEDULED status to check-in, current status is '{appt.status}'",
                "Conflict",
            )

        # checked_in_at must be within planned interval [start_at, end_at]
        start_utc = to_utc(appt.start_at)
        end_utc = to_utc(appt.end_at)
        chk_utc = to_utc(payload.checked_in_at)
        if not (start_utc <= chk_utc <= end_utc):
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"checked_in_at ({payload.checked_in_at.isoformat()}) must be within planned interval [{start_utc.isoformat()}, {end_utc.isoformat()}]",
                "Conflict",
            )

        appt.status = AppointmentStatusEnum.CHECKED_IN.value
        appt.checked_in_at = payload.checked_in_at
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(appt)
        return appt

@staticmethod
    def list_animals(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        species: Optional[SpeciesEnum],
        owner_id: Optional[int],
        unassigned: Optional[bool],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> AnimalListResponse:
        if owner_id is not None and unassigned is True:
            raise AppException(
                400, "owner_id and unassigned filters are mutually exclusive", "Bad Request"
            )

        query = select(AnimalModel).where(AnimalModel.is_deleted == False)

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            # Constrain to caller owner profile's ACTIVE ownership
            caller_owner = db.scalar(
                select(OwnerModel).where(
                    OwnerModel.account_id == current_user.id,
                    OwnerModel.is_deleted == False,
                )
            )
            if not caller_owner:
                return AnimalListResponse(items=[], limit=limit, next_after_id=None)

            active_animal_ids = select(OwnershipModel.animal_id).where(
                OwnershipModel.owner_id == caller_owner.id,
                OwnershipModel.status == OwnershipStatusEnum.ACTIVE.value,
            )
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.id.in_(active_animal_ids))
        else:
            # Admin filters
            if owner_id is not None:
                if owner_id <= 0:
                    raise AppException(404, f"Owner {owner_id} not found", "Not Found")
                owner = db.scalar(
                    select(OwnerModel).where(
                        OwnerModel.id == owner_id, OwnerModel.is_deleted == False
                    )
                )
                if not owner:
                    raise AppException(404, f"Owner {owner_id} not found", "Not Found")
                owned_animal_ids = select(OwnershipModel.animal_id).where(
                    OwnershipModel.owner_id == owner_id,
                    OwnershipModel.status == OwnershipStatusEnum.ACTIVE.value,
                )
                query = query.where(AnimalModel.id.in_(owned_animal_ids))

            if unassigned is True:
                active_animal_ids = select(OwnershipModel.animal_id).where(
                    OwnershipModel.status == OwnershipStatusEnum.ACTIVE.value
                )
                query = query.where(~AnimalModel.id.in_(active_animal_ids))

        if species is not None:
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.species == species.value)

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "after_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(AnimalModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        rows = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None
        if len(rows) > limit:
            items = rows[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = rows

        return AnimalListResponse(
            items=[AnimalResponse.model_validate(a) for a in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

    def create_ownership(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        animal_id: int,
        payload: OwnershipCreateRequest,
    ) -> OwnershipModel:
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Only admins may create ownership relations", "Forbidden")

        if animal_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")

        animal = db.scalar(
            select(AnimalModel).where(
                AnimalModel.id == animal_id, AnimalModel.is_deleted == False
            )
        )
        if not animal:
            raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")

        owner = db.scalar(
            select(OwnerModel).where(
                OwnerModel.id == payload.owner_id, OwnerModel.is_deleted == False
            )
        )
        if not owner:
            raise AppException(404, f"Owner {payload.owner_id} not found", "Not Found")

        # REQ-3-006: Check if animal already has an ACTIVE ownership
        active_own = db.scalar(
            select(OwnershipModel).where(
                OwnershipModel.animal_id == animal_id,
                OwnershipModel.status == OwnershipStatusEnum.ACTIVE.value,
            )
        )
        if active_own:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Animal {animal_id} already has an ACTIVE ownership (ID: {active_own.id})",
                "Conflict",
            )

        ownership = OwnershipModel(
            owner_id=payload.owner_id,
            animal_id=animal_id,
            started_on=payload.started_on,
            status=OwnershipStatusEnum.ACTIVE.value,
            ended_on=None,
        )
        db.add(ownership)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(ownership)
        return ownership

    def list_animals(

        current_user: UserModel,
        species: Optional[SpeciesEnum],
        active: Optional[bool],
        client_account_id: Optional[int],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> AnimalListResponse:
        if client_account_id is not None and current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "client_account_id filter permitted only to admins", "Forbidden")

        query = select(AnimalModel).where(AnimalModel.is_deleted == False)

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.client_account_id == current_user.id)
        elif client_account_id is not None:
            if client_account_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "client_account_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.client_account_id == client_account_id)

        if species is not None:
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.species == species.value)

        if active is not None:
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.active == active)

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "after_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(AnimalModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        rows = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None
        if len(rows) > limit:
            items = rows[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = rows

        return AnimalListResponse(
            items=[AnimalResponse.model_validate(a) for a in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def get_clinical_timeline(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        animal_id: int,
        event_from: Optional[date],
        event_to: Optional[date],
        include_void: bool,
        limit: int,
        after_event_date: Optional[date],
        after_event_kind: Optional[TimelineEventKindEnum],
        after_event_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> ClinicalTimelineResponse:
        AnimalController.get_animal(db, current_user, animal_id)

        if include_void and current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "include_void permitted only to admins", "Forbidden")

        # Validate three-part cursor: must be supplied together or omitted together
        cursor_parts = [after_event_date, after_event_kind, after_event_id]
        provided_parts = [p is not None for p in cursor_parts]
        if any(provided_parts) and not all(provided_parts):
            raise AppException(
                400,
                "after_event_date, after_event_kind, and after_event_id must be supplied together or omitted together",
                "Bad Request",
            )

        if after_event_id is not None and after_event_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(400, "after_event_id must be positive", "Bad Request")

        if event_from is not None and event_to is not None and event_from > event_to:
            raise AppException(400, "event_from cannot be later than event_to", "Bad Request")

        # 1. Fetch clinical records
        q_rec = select(ClinicalRecordModel).where(ClinicalRecordModel.animal_id == animal_id)
        if event_from is not None:
            q_rec = q_rec.where(ClinicalRecordModel.occurred_on >= event_from)
        if event_to is not None:
            q_rec = q_rec.where(ClinicalRecordModel.occurred_on <= event_to)
        recs = list(db.scalars(q_rec).all())

        # 2. Fetch vaccinations
        q_vac = select(VaccinationModel).where(VaccinationModel.animal_id == animal_id)
        if not include_void:
            q_vac = q_vac.where(VaccinationModel.is_void == False)
        if event_from is not None:
            q_vac = q_vac.where(VaccinationModel.administered_on >= event_from)
        if event_to is not None:
            q_vac = q_vac.where(VaccinationModel.administered_on <= event_to)
        vacs = list(db.scalars(q_vac).all())

        # 3. Merge into timeline items
        timeline: List[TimelineEventItem] = []
        for r in recs:
            timeline.append(
                TimelineEventItem(
                    event_id=r.id,
                    event_date=r.occurred_on,
                    event_kind=TimelineEventKindEnum.RECORD,
                    details={
                        "record_type": r.record_type,
                        "summary": r.summary,
                        "diagnosis_code": r.diagnosis_code,
                        "status": r.status,
                        "finalized_at": r.finalized_at.isoformat() if r.finalized_at else None,
                    },
                )
            )

        for v in vacs:
            timeline.append(
                TimelineEventItem(
                    event_id=v.id,
                    event_date=v.administered_on,
                    event_kind=TimelineEventKindEnum.VACCINATION,
                    details={
                        "vaccine_code": v.vaccine_code,
                        "vaccine_name": v.vaccine_name,
                        "expires_on": v.expires_on.isoformat(),
                        "batch_number": v.batch_number,
                        "is_void": v.is_void,
                        "void_reason": v.void_reason,
                    },
                )
            )

        # Sort order: event_date ascending, RECORD before VACCINATION, then event_id ascending
        def sort_key(item: TimelineEventItem):
            kind_rank = 0 if item.event_kind == TimelineEventKindEnum.RECORD else 1
            return (item.event_date, kind_rank, item.event_id)

        timeline.sort(key=sort_key)

        # Apply cursor if present
        if all(provided_parts):
            cursor_rank = 0 if after_event_kind == TimelineEventKindEnum.RECORD else 1
            cursor_tuple = (after_event_date, cursor_rank, after_event_id)
            timeline = [item for item in timeline if sort_key(item) > cursor_tuple]

        # Apply limit + next cursor
        next_date = None
        next_kind = None
        next_id = None
        if len(timeline) > limit:
            items = timeline[:limit]
            last = items[-1]
            next_date = last.event_date
            next_kind = last.event_kind
            next_id = last.event_id
        else:
            items = timeline

        return ClinicalTimelineResponse(
            items=items,
            limit=limit,
            next_after_event_date=next_date,
            next_after_event_kind=next_kind,
            next_after_event_id=next_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def get_vaccination_status(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        animal_id: int,
        as_of: date,
        requested_code: Optional[VaccineCodeEnum],
    ) -> VaccinationStatusResponse:
        AnimalController.get_animal(db, current_user, animal_id)

        # Codes to check
        codes = (
            [requested_code]
            if requested_code is not None
            else [c for c in VaccineCodeEnum]
        )

        query = select(VaccinationModel).where(
            VaccinationModel.animal_id == animal_id,
            VaccinationModel.is_void == False,
        )
        vacs = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        status_items: List[VaccineStatusItem] = []
        for code in codes:
            code_vacs = [v for v in vacs if v.vaccine_code == code.value]
            if not code_vacs:
                status_items.append(
                    VaccineStatusItem(
                        vaccine_code=code,
                        status=VaccinationStatusEnum.NOT_RECORDED,
                        administered_on=None,
                        expires_on=None,
                    )
                )
                continue

            # Sort by administered_on descending to find most relevant
            code_vacs.sort(key=lambda x: (x.administered_on, x.id), reverse=True)
            # Find if any non-void event is CURRENT: administered_on <= as_of and expires_on > as_of
            current_event = next(
                (v for v in code_vacs if v.administered_on <= as_of and v.expires_on > as_of),
                None,
            )
            if current_event:
                status_items.append(
                    VaccineStatusItem(
                        vaccine_code=code,
                        status=VaccinationStatusEnum.CURRENT,
                        administered_on=current_event.administered_on,
                        expires_on=current_event.expires_on,
                    )
                )
            else:
                # Expired event: expires_on <= as_of
                expired_event = next(
                    (v for v in code_vacs if v.expires_on <= as_of),
                    None,
                )
                if expired_event:
                    status_items.append(
                        VaccineStatusItem(
                            vaccine_code=code,
                            status=VaccinationStatusEnum.EXPIRED,
                            administered_on=expired_event.administered_on,
                            expires_on=expired_event.expires_on,
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    status_items.append(
                        VaccineStatusItem(
                            vaccine_code=code,
                            status=VaccinationStatusEnum.NOT_RECORDED,
                            administered_on=None,
                            expires_on=None,
                        )
                    )

        return VaccinationStatusResponse(
            animal_id=animal_id,
            as_of=as_of,
            statuses=status_items,
        )

    def list_records(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        animal_id: Optional[int],
        record_type: Optional[RecordTypeEnum],
        record_status: Optional[ClinicalRecordStatusEnum],
        occurred_from: Optional[date],
        occurred_to: Optional[date],
        diagnosis_code_prefix: Optional[str],
        limit: int,
        after_id: Optional[int],
    ) -> ClinicalRecordListResponse:
        query = select(ClinicalRecordModel).join(
            AnimalModel, ClinicalRecordModel.animal_id == AnimalModel.id
        ).where(AnimalModel.is_deleted == False)

        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.where(AnimalModel.client_account_id == current_user.id)

        if animal_id is not None:
            if animal_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")
            animal = db.scalar(
                select(AnimalModel).where(
                    AnimalModel.id == animal_id, AnimalModel.is_deleted == False
                )
            )
            if not animal:
                raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")
            if (
                current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value
                and animal.client_account_id != current_user.id
            ):
                raise AppException(403, "Access to animal records is forbidden", "Forbidden")
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.animal_id == animal_id)

        if record_type is not None:
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.record_type == record_type.value)

        if record_status is not None:
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.status == record_status.value)

        if occurred_from is not None and occurred_to is not None:
            if occurred_from > occurred_to:
                raise AppException(400, "occurred_from cannot be later than occurred_to", "Bad Request")

        if occurred_from is not None:
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.occurred_on >= occurred_from)

        if occurred_to is not None:
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.occurred_on <= occurred_to)

        if diagnosis_code_prefix is not None:
            pref = diagnosis_code_prefix.strip()
            if not (1 <= len(pref) <= 20) or not re.match(r"^[A-Z0-9.-]+$", pref):
                raise AppException(400, "Invalid diagnosis_code_prefix", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.diagnosis_code.startswith(pref))

        if after_id is not None:
            if after_id <= 0:
                raise AppException(400, "after_id must be positive", "Bad Request")
            query = query.where(ClinicalRecordModel.id > after_id)

        query = query.order_by(ClinicalRecordModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1)
        rows = list(db.scalars(query).all())

        next_after_id = None
        if len(rows) > limit:
            items = rows[:limit]
            next_after_id = items[-1].id
        else:
            items = rows

        return ClinicalRecordListResponse(
            items=[ClinicalRecordResponse.model_validate(r) for r in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def create_vaccination(
        db: Session,
        current_user: UserModel,
        animal_id: int,
        payload: VaccinationCreateRequest,
    ) -> VaccinationModel:
        if current_user.role != RoleEnum.ADMIN.value:
            raise AppException(403, "Only admins may create vaccinations", "Forbidden")

        if animal_id <= 0:
            raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")

        animal = db.scalar(
            select(AnimalModel).where(
                AnimalModel.id == animal_id, AnimalModel.is_deleted == False
            )
        )
        if not animal:
            raise AppException(404, f"Animal {animal_id} not found", "Not Found")

        # REQ-3-005: expires_on strictly later than administered_on and no more than 1095 calendar days later
        if payload.expires_on <= payload.administered_on:
            raise AppException(
                422, "expires_on must be strictly later than administered_on", "Unprocessable Entity"
            )

        days_diff = (payload.expires_on - payload.administered_on).days
        if days_diff > 1095:
            raise AppException(
                422,
                f"expires_on cannot be more than 1095 calendar days later than administered_on, got {days_diff} days",
                "Unprocessable Entity",
            )

        # REQ-3-006: For a non-void vaccination, (animal_id, vaccine_code, administered_on) is unique
        dup = db.scalar(
            select(VaccinationModel).where(
                VaccinationModel.animal_id == animal_id,
                VaccinationModel.vaccine_code == payload.vaccine_code.value,
                VaccinationModel.administered_on == payload.administered_on,
                VaccinationModel.is_void == False,
            )
        )
        if dup:
            raise AppException(
                409,
                f"Active vaccination for {payload.vaccine_code.value} on {payload.administered_on.isoformat()} already exists",
                "Conflict",
            )

        vac = VaccinationModel(
            animal_id=animal_id,
            vaccine_code=payload.vaccine_code.value,
            vaccine_name=payload.vaccine_name,
            administered_on=payload.administered_on,
            expires_on=payload.expires_on,
            batch_number=payload.batch_number,
            is_void=False,
            voided_on=None,
            void_reason=None,
            voided_by=None,
        )
        db.add(vac)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(vac)
        return vac

    def list_ingredients(
        db: Session,
        limit: int = 20,
        after_id: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> IngredientListResponseSchema:
        query = db.query(IngredientModel)
        if after_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(IngredientModel.id > after_id)

        rows = query.order_by(IngredientModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1).all()
        has_more = len(rows) > limit
        items = rows[:limit]
        next_after_id = items[-1].id if has_more and items else None

        return IngredientListResponseSchema(
            items=[
                IngredientResponseSchema(
                    id=ing.id,
                    name=ing.name,
                    unit=UnitEnum(ing.unit),
                    created_at=ing.created_at,
                    updated_at=ing.updated_at,
                )
                for ing in items
            ],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def patch_ingredient(db: Session, ingredient_id: int, payload: IngredientPatchSchema) -> IngredientModel:
        ing = db.query(IngredientModel).filter(IngredientModel.id == ingredient_id).first()
        if not ing:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Ingredient {ingredient_id} not found",
            )

        if payload.name is not None and payload.name != ing.name:
            existing = db.query(IngredientModel).filter(
                IngredientModel.name == payload.name,
                IngredientModel.id != ingredient_id,
            ).first()
            if existing:
                raise StarletteHTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail=f"Ingredient with name '{payload.name}' already exists",
                )
            ing.name = payload.name

        if payload.unit is not None and payload.unit.value != ing.unit:
            # Check if referenced components exist
            has_components = db.query(RecipeComponentModel).filter(
                RecipeComponentModel.ingredient_id == ingredient_id
            ).first() is not None
            if has_components:
                raise StarletteHTTPException(
                    status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                    detail="Cannot change unit of ingredient referenced by existing recipe components",
                )
            ing.unit = payload.unit.value

        ing.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(ing)
        return ing

                        status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                        detail=f"Ingredient {c.ingredient_id} not found",

                # REQ-10-004: matching unit

                        status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
                        detail=f"Component unit '{c.unit.value}' does not match ingredient unit '{ing.unit}'",

                    recipe_id=recipe.id,
                    ingredient_id=c.ingredient_id,
                    quantity=c.quantity,

        scale_ratio = new_servings / (source_recipe.servings if source_recipe.servings > 0 else 1)

        new_title = payload.new_title if payload.new_title is not None else f"Copy of {source_recipe.title}"

        new_recipe = RecipeModel(
            user_id=user.id,
            title=new_title,
            instructions=source_recipe.instructions,
            servings=new_servings,
        )
        db.add(new_recipe)
        db.flush()

        for c in source_recipe.components:
            scaled_qty = round(c.quantity * scale_ratio, 4)
            comp = RecipeComponentModel(
                recipe_id=new_recipe.id,
                ingredient_id=c.ingredient_id,
                quantity=scaled_qty,
                unit=c.unit,
            )
            db.add(comp)

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_recipe)

@staticmethod
    def search_recipes(
        db: Session,
        tag_ids: Optional[List[int]] = None,
        max_calories: Optional[float] = None,
        min_protein: Optional[float] = None,
        q: Optional[str] = None,
        limit: int = 20,
        after_id: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> RecipeListResponseSchema:
        query = db.query(RecipeModel)
        if after_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(RecipeModel.id > after_id)

        all_recipes = query.order_by(RecipeModel.id.asc()).all()
        matched: List[RecipeModel] = []

        for r in all_recipes:
            # Filter q (literal search 1..80 in title or instructions)
            if q is not None and q.strip():
                search_term = q.strip().lower()
                if search_term not in r.title.lower() and search_term not in r.instructions.lower():
                    continue

            # Filter tag_ids (AND semantics: must contain all tag_ids)
            if tag_ids:
                r_tag_ids = {rt.tag_id for rt in r.recipe_tags}
                if not all(t_id in r_tag_ids for t_id in tag_ids):
                    continue

            # Calculate nutrition if needed for filters
            if max_calories is not None or min_protein is not None:
                total_kcal = 0.0
                total_prot = 0.0
                for c in r.components:
                    ratio = c.quantity_grams / 100.0
                    total_kcal += c.ingredient.calories_kcal * ratio
                    total_prot += c.ingredient.protein_g * ratio

                if max_calories is not None and total_kcal > max_calories:
                    continue
                if min_protein is not None and total_prot < min_protein:
                    continue

            matched.append(r)

        has_more = len(matched) > limit
        items = matched[:limit]
        next_after_id = items[-1].id if has_more and items else None

        return RecipeListResponseSchema(
            items=[RecipeVariantCController._format_recipe(r) for r in items],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

    def patch_recipe(
        db: Session,
        recipe_id: int,
        user: UserModel,
        payload: RecipePatchSchema,
    ) -> RecipeModel:
        recipe = db.query(RecipeModel).filter(RecipeModel.id == recipe_id).first()
        if not recipe:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                detail=f"Recipe {recipe_id} not found",
            )

        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value and recipe.user_id != user.id:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
                detail="Not authorized to update this recipe",
            )

        if payload.title is not None:
            recipe.title = payload.title
        if payload.instructions is not None:
            recipe.instructions = payload.instructions
        if payload.servings is not None:
            recipe.servings = payload.servings

        if payload.components is not None:
            # Replace components
            db.query(RecipeComponentModel).filter(RecipeComponentModel.recipe_id == recipe_id).delete()
            seen_ingredients = set()
            for comp in payload.components:
                if comp.ingredient_id in seen_ingredients:
                    raise StarletteHTTPException(
                        status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                        detail=f"Duplicate ingredient {comp.ingredient_id} in recipe components",
                    )
                seen_ingredients.add(comp.ingredient_id)
                ing = db.query(IngredientModel).filter(IngredientModel.id == comp.ingredient_id).first()
                if not ing:
                    raise StarletteHTTPException(
                        status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND,
                        detail=f"Ingredient {comp.ingredient_id} not found",
                    )
                rc = RecipeComponentModel(
                    recipe_id=recipe.id,
                    ingredient_id=comp.ingredient_id,
                    quantity_grams=comp.quantity_grams,
                )
                db.add(rc)

        recipe.updated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(recipe)
        return recipe

    def list_meal_entries(
        db: Session,
        user: UserModel,
        plan_id: Optional[int] = None,
        day: Optional[DayOfWeekEnum] = None,
        meal: Optional[MealTypeEnum] = None,
        limit: int = 20,
        after_id: Optional[int] = None,
    ) -> MealEntryListResponseSchema:
        query = db.query(MealEntryModel).join(MealPlanModel)
        if user.role != UserRole.ADMIN.value:
            query = query.filter(MealPlanModel.user_id == user.id)

        if plan_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(MealEntryModel.plan_id == plan_id)
        if day is not None:
            query = query.filter(MealEntryModel.day == day.value)
        if meal is not None:
            query = query.filter(MealEntryModel.meal == meal.value)
        if after_id is not None:
            query = query.filter(MealEntryModel.id > after_id)

        rows = query.order_by(MealEntryModel.id.asc()).limit(limit + 1).all()
        has_more = len(rows) > limit
        items = rows[:limit]
        next_after_id = items[-1].id if has_more and items else None

        return MealEntryListResponseSchema(
            items=[
                MealEntryResponseSchema(
                    id=e.id,
                    plan_id=e.plan_id,
                    recipe_id=e.recipe_id,
                    recipe_title=e.recipe.title,
                    day=DayOfWeekEnum(e.day),
                    meal=MealTypeEnum(e.meal),
                    servings=e.servings,
                    created_at=e.created_at,
                    updated_at=e.updated_at,
                )
                for e in items
            ],
            limit=limit,
            next_after_id=next_after_id,
        )

@staticmethod
    def get_shopping_list(db: Session, plan_id: int, user: UserModel) -> ShoppingListResponseSchema:
        plan = RecipeVariantBController.get_meal_plan(db, plan_id, user)
        aggregated: Dict[tuple[str, str], float] = {}

        for entry in plan.entries:
            ratio = entry.servings / (entry.recipe.base_servings if entry.recipe.base_servings > 0 else 1.0)
            for ing in entry.recipe.ingredients:
                key = (ing.name.strip().title(), ing.unit.strip().upper())
                aggregated[key] = aggregated.get(key, 0.0) + (ing.quantity * ratio)

        items = [
            ShoppingListItemSchema(
                name=name,
                total_quantity=round(qty, 2),
                unit=unit,
            )
            for (name, unit), qty in sorted(aggregated.items())
        ]

        return ShoppingListResponseSchema(
            plan_id=plan.id,
            week_start_date=plan.week_start_date,
            items=items,
        )

    def copy_week(
        db: Session,
        plan_id: int,
        user: UserModel,
        payload: CopyWeekSchema,
    ) -> MealPlanModel:
        source_plan = RecipeVariantBController.get_meal_plan(db, plan_id, user)

        # Check if user already has a plan for target week
        existing = db.query(MealPlanModel).filter(
            MealPlanModel.user_id == user.id,
            MealPlanModel.week_start_date == payload.target_week_start_date,
        ).first()
        if existing:
            raise StarletteHTTPException(
                status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
                detail=f"Meal plan for week starting {payload.target_week_start_date} already exists for this user",
            )

        new_plan = MealPlanModel(
            user_id=user.id,
            week_start_date=payload.target_week_start_date,
            note=f"Copied from week {source_plan.week_start_date}",
        )
        db.add(new_plan)
        db.flush()

        # Copy entries
        for e in source_plan.entries:
            copy_entry = MealEntryModel(
                plan_id=new_plan.id,
                recipe_id=e.recipe_id,
                day=e.day,
                meal=e.meal,
                servings=e.servings,
            )
            db.add(copy_entry)

        db.commit()
        db.refresh(new_plan)
        return new_plan

    def create_recipe(db: Session, payload: RecipeCreateSchema) -> RecipeModel:

            is_active=payload.is_active,

                    recipe_id=recipe.id,
                    name=item.name,
                    quantity=item.quantity,
                    unit=item.unit,
